messages.content: 這家企業的營收為15000美元，總成本為22000美元，回報率是多少？

function.name: investment_analysis_calculate_profit
function.description: Calculates the net profit given the total revenue and total cost Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

total_revenue.description: The total revenue for the business. This is a float type value.

total_cost.description: The total cost for the business. This is a float type value.

tax_rate.description: The tax rate for the business, default is 0.2. This is a float type value.

message.reasoning: We need to calculate net profit: revenue - cost = -7000. Then tax? The function calculates net profit given revenue, cost, tax_rate. But we want return rate? Return rate likely net profit / cost? Or net profit / revenue? Usually return on investment (ROI) = (net profit / total cost) * 100%. So ROI = (-7000 / 22000)*100% = -31.818%. But the function calculates net profit after tax. We can call function with tax_rate default 0.2. That will compute net profit after tax: net_profit = (revenue - cost) * (1 - tax_rate). Wait the function description: "Calculates the net profit given the total revenue and total cost Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax." It says tax_rate default 0.2. So net profit = (total_revenue - total_cost) * (1 - tax_rate). So net profit = (-7000)*(0.8) = -5600. Then ROI = net profit / total_cost = -5600/22000 = -0.2545 => -25.45%.
